channel.description:
How much does a goat cost? What does it cost to keep a horse? How much do farmers really make?

The Farm Ledger answers the money questions behind farming and ranching in short, fact-checked videos: what animals cost to buy and raise, feed and hay prices, egg and beef prices, and what ends up in the farmer's pocket. Numbers come from USDA (ERS, NASS, AMS) and university extension data, with sources in every description.

New Shorts every day at 6 PM Central, plus a longer explainer video every week.

🛒 Cattle gear we talk about (Amazon): https://www.amazon.com/s?k=cattle+supplies+ranch&tag=thecattleledger-20
